title: Canonical second pullback comparison and forward projection
statement: For the rational or closure coefficient of [def-sfb-rational-tate-pullback-comparison], a field k of characteristic p different from l, a k-scheme Y and any derived K on Y, let M=q*K(1)[2]. Construct p1*M ≅ p2*M by commuting pullback with the fixed tensor/shift twist, the canonical self-square pullback comparison on K, and the normalized Cartesian Tate comparisons. Define J_K: M tensor Rp2*(Lambda_W(1)[2]) → Rp2*(p1*M(1)[2]) to be the forward left-factor p2 projection followed by the inverse of that pullback comparison tensor identity and the native tensor-shift comparison. No map is selected from a bare existence assertion. The helper secondDiagramPushIso identifies the recorded normalized Diagram.R2 with the fixed module-object pushforward through Diagram.p2_canonical; it only wraps the published equality and does not choose a new identification.

proof.text: Construct pullTwistIso from mapIso of inverse tensorShiftIso, the published pullback tensor isomorphism, tensor with the given Tate comparison, and tensorShiftIso. Compose it for p1 and p2 around the self-square comparison on q*K. Install the residue-field invertibility proofs to use the canonical shifted Tate comparisons. Compose the published forward left-factor projection with tensor of the inverse resulting comparison and the identity on the shifted Tate line.

mathlib_searches.query: The projection formula for a section identifies the pushforward of the diagonal class tensored with an object with the object tensored with the diagonal integral
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits, including pullback.diagonal_fst, diagonalObjPullbackFstIso_inv_snd_fst, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_obj_obj and LinearMap.proj_comp_single. They concern ordinary pullback geometry, sheaf sections or linear algebra, not the derived section/projection or trace-tail equations.

mathlib_searches.query: In a symmetric monoidal category the diagonal kernel unit followed by pullback of the trace counit is identity tensor the diagonal integral
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits: Functor.diag tensor coherences, Dial.triangle, ExactPairing.coevaluation_evaluation and externalProductCompDiagIso components. None addresses geometric diagonal insertion or trace base change.

RationalP1AmbientComposites defines the maps but proves no contraction. The tower modules TowerP1TriangleFactorization, TowerP1SecondTraceReordering and TowerP1DiagonalProjectionFactor supply an analogous decomposition on a different tower-system category. The generic ringed section/projection and exchange/tensor theorems need normalization transport to the present internal-module category.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the canonical ambient maps and split the insertion and trace-tail equations.

mathlib_searches.results: msearch Mathlib grep returned 12 hits: Condensed.Discrete.LocallyConstant projection of counit, group-functor section projections, extra degeneracies, hypercovers and Nobeling. None gives the derived geometric contraction or its two component equations.
